note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: two dated outbound customs records (11.12.2025) to Azista Bhutan Healthcare Ltd. via Darranaga LCS under B/L 7770316, HS 39233090 (plastic containers/caps) — i.e. the company actually ships pharma packaging to Bhutan. Declared HS 392350 (stoppers/caps/lids) is close but the customs line carries 39233090 (carboys/bottles/flasks); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual code should be recorded as 39233090 (with 392350 plausible for the cap line), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The same record set also shows the company importing moulds from China (HS 84807900), consistent with an actual manufacturer of plastic packaging rather than a pure trader.
